name: Pokhara
summary: Pokhara is Nepal's relaxed lakeside town under the Annapurna range. Paddle on Phewa Lake, watch sunrise over Machapuchare from Sarangkot, paraglide over the lake, walk to the World Peace Pagoda and start treks like Poon Hill and Annapurna Base Camp.
seasonNote: October to November gives the clearest mountain views; spring brings rhododendrons.
arrival: Pokhara International Airport, a 25-minute flight from Kathmandu, or 7 hours by bus.
cashTip: Carry rupees for trekking, teahouses and taxis; ATMs exist in Lakeside but not on trails.
